title: Binding of stress-responsive OsWRKY proteins through WRKYGQK heptapeptide residue with the promoter region of two rice blast disease resistance genes Pi2 and Pi54 is important for development of blast resistance.
authors: Meher, Jhumishree; Sarkar, Ankita; Sarma, Birinchi Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过同源建模与HDOCK分子对接，研究水稻WRKY转录因子与抗稻瘟病基因启动子的蛋白-DNA结合模式，聚焦WRKYGQK保守肽段在互作中的作用，属于TF-DNA互作建模研究，但方法较常规、深度有限。
abstract: Molecular docking was done to investigate the interactions between five differentially expressed rice WRKY proteins when challenged with the rice blast disease caused by Magnaporthe oryzae and drought stresses applied either individually or overlapped, with the promoter region of two blast resistance genes (Pi2 and Pi54). Molecular docking was performed using the HDOCK server. Initially, the homology models for each of the five rice WRKY proteins were prepared using I-TASSER server, and then the secondary structure as well as the DNA-binding pockets were predicted using PSIPRED and BindUP servers, respectively. The molecular docking study revealed a differential binding pattern of the rice WRKYs with the two blast resistance genes. The WRKY proteins (OsWRKY88 and OsWRKY102), whose transcript levels decrease when drought and blast stresses are overlapped, interact with the two resistance genes mostly involving the residues of the zinc finger structure. On the other hand, the WRKY proteins (OsWRKY53-1 and OsWRKY113), whose transcript levels did not reduce significantly when challenged by drought and blast overlapped condition compared to individual treatment of blast, interact mostly involving the residues of the conserved WRKYGQK heptapeptide sequence. Interestingly, the protein OsWRKY74 whose transcript levels are unaffected in both individual and overlapped stresses, interacts with both the blast resistance genes involving few residues of both WRKYGQK heptapeptide and the zinc finger structure. The findings thus indicate that the interaction of OsWRKY proteins involving the conserved WRKYGQK heptapeptide sequence with the blast resistance genes Pi2 and Pi54 is important to mitigate the blast challenge in rice even during overlapping challenges of drought. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1007/s13205-023-03711-y.
abstract_zh: 采用分子对接技术，研究了五个差异表达的水稻WRKY蛋白在稻瘟病（由稻瘟病菌Magnaporthe oryzae引起）和干旱胁迫单独或重叠处理下，与两个抗稻瘟病基因（Pi2和Pi54）启动子区域的相互作用。分子对接使用HDOCK服务器进行。首先，利用I-TASSER服务器为五个水稻WRKY蛋白分别构建同源模型，随后分别使用PSIPRED和BindUP服务器预测其二级结构及DNA结合口袋。分子对接研究揭示了水稻WRKY蛋白与两个抗稻瘟病基因的差异结合模式。当干旱和稻瘟病胁迫重叠时，转录水平下降的WRKY蛋白（OsWRKY88和OsWRKY102）与两个抗性基因的相互作用主要涉及锌指结构的残基。另一方面，与单独稻瘟病处理相比，在干旱和稻瘟病重叠条件下转录水平未显著降低的WRKY蛋白（OsWRKY53-1和OsWRKY113），其相互作用主要涉及保守的WRKYGQK七肽序列的残基。有趣的是，在单独和重叠胁迫下转录水平均不受影响的蛋白OsWRKY74，与两个抗稻瘟病基因的相互作用涉及WRKYGQK七肽和锌指结构的少数残基。因此，研究结果表明，OsWRKY蛋白通过保守的WRKYGQK七肽序列与抗稻瘟病基因Pi2和Pi54的相互作用，对于水稻在干旱重叠挑战下缓解稻瘟病危害至关重要。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可访问10.1007/s13205-023-03711-y获取。
